provenance.gather: S is a thin box around s = 0.07, measured only at s = 0.07 (a box needs low < high), delta 0.005-0.015. Decided by Josh, 2026-11-25 (option a), after a per-start-type probe (code 11efe9fa5, gather-starts/probe_v3.py; robot = after a failing gather at (0.07, 0.16) then robot_reset, human = after reset_movables('human_reset'), fresh = episode start; 20 starts per cell per start type; gather x/starts, then sweep5 d = 0.10 x/successful gathers). s = 0.07: delta 0.005 fresh 20/20 / 20/20, robot 18/20 / 17/18, human 20/20 / 20/20; delta 0.015 fresh 20/20 / 19/20, robot 18/20 / 18/18, human 20/20 / 19/20; delta 0.03 fresh 20/20 / 20/20, robot 18/20 / 17/18, human 20/20 / 17/20 (excluded: sweep5 after it below 18/20). The 6 robot-start gather failures at s = 0.07 are the same two starts at every delta (run seed 3 task 0, run seed 4 task 0), so realised gather success after a robot_reset is about 0.9 alpha(n): 18/20 accepted on robot starts (Josh, 2026-11-25). robot_reset parks the robot near the rack (base x 2.026, y -0.033, yaw 2.842, spread 0.015 / 0.027 / 0.054) with a different arm configuration; human_reset restores the home pose (base 0, 0, 0). Robot starts at s = 0.05 gather 6/30 and at s = 0.06 8/29 (all deltas pooled), so the earlier fresh-start box s in [0.05, 0.07] was wrong for practice, which starts after robot_reset. Earlier fresh-start measurements (code e89b22dc2): (0.05, 0.005) 20/20 / 19/20; (0.05, 0.03) 20/20 / 20/20; (0.07, 0.005) 20/20 / 20/20; (0.07, 0.03) 20/20 / 20/20; s = 0.03 gathers 17/20 at both deltas; (0.09, 0.03) leaves sweep5 15/20; s = 0.11 leaves sweep5 17/20 (delta 0.005) and 15/20 (delta 0.03). These results predate the controller fix reverting #926's human-reset robot pose. F: delta 0.12 at s = 0.03, 0.07, 0.11 all 0/20 (this code); delta 0.20 at s = 0.03, 0.05, 0.07, 0.09, 0.11 all 0/20 (this code); delta 0.12 and 0.18 at s = 0.03-0.11 all 0/20 on v2's launch code (calib/table-0.09.txt).
